params.1273: Collect tickets in the Brimhaven Agility Arena.
params.1274: Enter the hut and speak to Cap'n Izzy No-Beard.
params.1275: Ask to enter the Agility Arena and pay him 200 coins.
params.1276: Climb down the ladder in the hut.
params.1277: Go around the arena tagging the active ticket dispensers for a ticket.
params.1278: You can later exchange the tickets for more Agility experience with Pirate Jackie the Fruit.
